comparison.objective: Operate a straw dispenser and place one straw standing in each of five glasses.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a spring-return handle while extracting and slant-inserting straws, not hammering or fracture control.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly one suitably deep, slanted straw remains in each upright glass.
comparison.reason: Repeated bimanual tool access and insertion are generic overlaps; there is no notch fracture, insert preservation, or fragment containment. No specs or numeric glass-knock thresholds are supplied beyond stated dimensions.
